final: WITH per_item AS (SELECT ili.order_item_id, c.town_city AS town, AVG(ili.product_price) AS avg_price, AVG(ili.derived_product_cost * 1.0 / ili.derived_total_cost) AS avg_ratio FROM Invoice_Line_Items ili JOIN Order_Items oi ON oi.order_item_id = ili.order_item_id JOIN Orders o ON o.order_id = oi.order_id JOIN Customers c ON c.customer_id = o.customer_id GROUP BY ili.order_item_id, c.town_city), per_town AS (SELECT town, AVG(avg_price) AS avg_price, AVG(avg_ratio) AS avg_ratio FROM per_item GROUP BY town) SELECT town, avg_price, avg_ratio, avg_ratio - (SELECT AVG(avg_ratio) FROM per_town) AS diff_above_avg FROM per_town WHERE avg_ratio > (SELECT AVG(avg_ratio) FROM per_town) ORDER BY avg_ratio DESC
